info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Utility Billing Plans-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Plans Information API provides insights into available utility billing plans for customers. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of billing plans, showcasing various pricing structures and features tailored to different consumer needs. Typical consumers of this API include utility companies, billing software developers, and financial analysts seeking to understand billing options. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experiences by integrating up-to-date billing plan information into their applications.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of the current billing plan associated with your account. You can use this information to understand your billing structure and any associated costs.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving billing plan information. This body should provide necessary details to specify the billing plan being queried.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the billing plan details.
